'''Shield 11 ("Shield Chrono(V)/We Shall Receive").''' On the sheet (page 34 of [[:File:2007 Worlds Day 2.pdf]], [[:File:2007 Worlds Day 2 p34 Jonny Chu LS.png|scan]]) shield 11 is hard to read, roughly "Chrono (V)". No card is called "We Shall Receive", and the only "We Shall" card, [[We Shall Double Our Efforts!]], is Dark Side. The decklist gives this shield as [[Ultimatum (Reflections III)|Ultimatum]], the Light Side Defensive Shield; sheet line 12 is [[Disarming Creature (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm) (Original)|Disarming Creature (V)]]. --[[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 00:21, 21 October 2026 (UTC)
